name: Chirer Polao
ingredients: 2 cups thin or medium poha (flattened rice)
instructions: 1. Rinse the poha in a strainer under cold running water for a few seconds until soft but not mushy; drain completely and set aside.
2. Heat mustard oil in a pan until it smokes slightly, then add mustard seeds and curry leaves.
3. Add the peanuts and fry until golden brown.
4. Add potatoes, carrots, and green peas; sauté until the vegetables are cooked through.
5. Add turmeric, salt, sugar, and green chilies, mixing well.
6. Gently fold in the drained poha, ensuring the grains are coated with the spices without breaking them.
7. Cover and steam on low heat for 2 minutes.
8. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.
description: Chirer Polao is a quintessential Bengali comfort food, often served as a light breakfast or a snack during Pujo. It is a nutritious, quick-to-prepare dish that highlights the use of flattened rice and the pungent, signature flavor of mustard oil.
